subject: english
title: 七下早鸟卷 · 英语
source: 考查范围：七年级上下册，以七下为主（动物、规则、运动健康、饮食、现在进行时、天气、一般过去时、故事），按期末考试题型编写（不含听力），难度略高，百分制
note: 51 题，不含听力，百分制，考到七年级下册

items.stem:
—Look! The children ______ kites in the park.
—How happy they are!
items.exp: Look! 提示动作正在发生，用现在进行时 are flying。

items.stem:
—______ was the weather like in Harbin yesterday?
—It was snowy and very cold.
items.exp: What's the weather like? 是固定问法，相当于 How is the weather?。注意有 like 时用 what。

items.stem: In our school, we ______ wear school uniforms on Mondays, but we ______ wear them on Fridays. We can wear our own clothes.
items.exp: 周一必须穿校服 must；周五“不必”穿，用 don't have to。mustn't 是“禁止”，与后句“可以穿自己的衣服”不符。

items.stem: Don't ______ in the hallways. You may hurt yourself or others.
items.exp: 否定祈使句：Don't＋动词原形。

items.stem: To keep healthy, you should eat more ______ and less ______.
items.kp: 可数名词与不可数名词
items.exp: vegetable 是可数名词，more 后用复数；junk food 是不可数名词，less 修饰不可数名词。

items.stem:
—What did you do last weekend?
—I ______ my grandparents and ______ them clean the house.
items.exp: last weekend 是过去时间，两个并列动词都用过去式。

items.stem: There ______ a football match on TV yesterday evening, but my father ______ busy and didn't watch it.
items.exp: yesterday evening 用过去时；a football match 单数用 was；my father 单数用 was。

items.stem:
—How often do you exercise?
—______. I run every morning.
items.exp: How often 问频率，回答 Every day。For an hour 回答 How long。

items.stem: Pandas are in great danger. We must do something ______ them.
items.exp: do something to do sth. 做些事情来……，不定式表目的。

items.stem:
—I'm sorry I broke your cup.
—______. It's an old one.
items.exp: 回应道歉用 Never mind（没关系）。

sections.title: A Day to Remember
sections.passage:
Last Saturday was a special day for me. My class went to a farm outside the city. We (11) there by bus early in the morning.
The weather was (12). The sun was shining and there were no clouds in the sky. When we got to the farm, a farmer showed us (13) the farm. We saw many cows, sheep and chickens. Then the farmer (14) us how to milk a cow. It looked easy, but when I tried, the cow didn't move and no milk came out! Everyone (15).
After lunch, we went to pick strawberries. The strawberries were big and red. We picked a lot and the farmer let us (16) some for free. They were so (17)! At about three o'clock, it suddenly began to (18). We ran into a big house and waited there. Luckily, the rain (19) after twenty minutes.
We got back to school at five. I was tired (20) very happy. I learned a lot about farm life. It was a day to remember!

items.exp: 讲上周六的事，用过去式 went。
后句说阳光明媚、没有云，天气晴朗。
show sb. around 带某人参观。
teach sb. how to do sth. 教某人怎样做某事。
挤不出奶的样子很滑稽，大家都笑了。
let sb. do sth.，let 后接动词原形。
又大又红的草莓吃起来很美味。
后文说 the rain，所以是下雨。
Luckily 幸运的是，雨二十分钟后停了。
累但很开心，前后转折，用 but。

groups.label: A
groups.title: Rules at Sunshine Swimming Pool
groups.passage:
Welcome to Sunshine Swimming Pool!
Opening hours: Tuesday–Sunday 9:00 am–8:00 pm (closed on Mondays)
Tickets: Adults ¥40, Students ¥25 (please show your student card), Children under 6 free
Rules:
1. Take a shower before you swim.
2. Wear a swimming cap in the pool.
3. Don't run or jump into the pool.
4. Don't eat or drink in the pool area.
5. Children under 12 must swim with an adult.
6. Leave the pool when you hear thunder.
Call 6233-0875 if you have any questions.

items.stem: When can't people swim at the pool?
items.exp: closed on Mondays。

items.stem: Mr. Wang, his 13-year-old son and his 5-year-old daughter go swimming together. How much do they need to pay? (The son shows his student card.)
items.exp: 成人 40 元，学生 25 元，6 岁以下儿童免费：40＋25＝65 元。

items.stem: What should you do before swimming?
items.exp: 规则 1：Take a shower before you swim。

items.stem: Which of the following is NOT allowed?
options: Drinking juice in the pool area.
Leaving the pool when it thunders.
items.exp: 规则 4：泳池区域禁止吃喝。

items.stem: Who can swim without an adult?
items.exp: 12 岁以下必须有成人陪同，只有 14 岁的男孩可以单独游泳。

groups.label: B
groups.title: The Clever Crow
groups.passage:
Once upon a time, there was a crow. One hot summer day, she flew for a long time looking for water. She was very thirsty.
At last, she saw a bottle under a tree. There was some water in it, but the water was at the bottom, and the neck of the bottle was too narrow. The crow put her beak into the bottle, but she couldn't reach the water.
The crow didn't give up. She looked around and saw some small stones on the ground. She had an idea! She picked up a stone and dropped it into the bottle. Then she dropped another one, and another. Slowly, the water came up higher and higher.
Finally, the water was high enough. The crow drank the water happily and then flew away.
The story tells us that we should use our heads when we have problems. Where there is a will, there is a way.

items.stem: Why did the crow look for water?
items.exp: She was very thirsty。

items.stem: Why couldn't the crow drink the water at first?
options: The water was too low and the bottle neck was narrow.
items.exp: 水在瓶底，瓶颈太窄，喙够不到。

items.stem: What did the crow drop into the bottle?
items.exp: She picked up a stone and dropped it into the bottle。

items.stem: What does the underlined word "narrow" probably mean?
items.exp: 瓶颈 narrow，乌鸦的喙伸进去够不着水，可推断是“窄的”。

items.stem: What can we learn from the story?
options: We should think hard to solve problems.
We should never drink from bottles.
items.exp: use our heads when we have problems，遇到问题要动脑筋。

groups.label: C
groups.title: Eat Well, Keep Fit
groups.passage:
Many students know that eating well and exercising are important, but not all of them do it.
Last month, Green Middle School asked 500 students about their habits. The results showed that only 30% of them ate breakfast every day. About half of the students drank sweet drinks more than three times a week. And 40% of them exercised for less than half an hour a day.
Dr. Li, a doctor at the city hospital, gives students some advice. "First, never skip breakfast. It gives you energy for the morning. Second, drink more water instead of sweet drinks. Third, try to exercise for at least one hour every day. You can walk to school, play ball games or ride a bike."
Dr. Li also says, "Don't eat too much at night, and go to bed early. Good sleep helps you study better."

items.stem: How many students in the survey ate breakfast every day?
What does Dr. Li say about breakfast?
options: It gives you energy for the morning.
You can eat it at noon.
Sweet drinks are good for breakfast.
items.exp: It gives you energy for the morning。

items.stem: How long should students exercise every day according to Dr. Li?
items.exp: at least one hour every day。

items.stem: Which is NOT Dr. Li's advice?
options: Ride a bike or walk to school.
Eat a big dinner late at night.
items.exp: Don't eat too much at night。

items.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: Students' habits and advice for a healthy life.
items.exp: 先讲学生习惯调查结果，再给出健康生活建议。

sections.title: How to Keep a Pet Dog
sections.passage:
Dogs are friendly and clever. Many people like to keep dogs as pets. If you want to keep a dog, here are some tips for you.
Give your dog the right food. (36) Some food for people, like chocolate, is bad for dogs.
Take your dog out for a walk every day. Dogs need exercise, just like people. (37)
Keep your dog clean. Wash it once or twice a month. (38)
Take it to see a vet. (39) If your dog doesn't want to eat or play, take it to see a vet at once.
Love your dog. Play with it and talk to it. (40) Then it will be your best friend.
choices: Dog food is better than the food you eat.
A short walk after meals is good for them.
Brush its hair often to keep it tidy.
A vet is a doctor for animals.
You can buy a dog in a shop.

items.exp: 本段讲给狗吃合适的食物，狗粮比人的食物更好，后句举巧克力的例子。
本段讲每天遛狗、需要运动，B 补充饭后散步有好处。
本段讲保持清洁，洗澡、梳毛。
空格后再次出现 vet，D 解释 vet 是动物医生。
爱护狗、陪它玩，狗能感受到你的爱。

sections.title: My Weekend
sections.passage:
Dear Tom,
Thanks for your e-mail. I had a busy but (41) (interest) weekend.
On Saturday morning, I (42) (get) up early and went to the park with my father. We (43) (run) for half an hour. Then we had breakfast in a small restaurant. I had two (44) (egg) and a glass of milk.
In the afternoon, it was (45) (rain), so I stayed at home. I read a book about animals. Did you know that elephants can live (46) ______ about seventy years? I also learned that (47) (wolf) usually live and hunt in groups.
On Sunday, my aunt and her son came to visit us. My cousin is only five, but he can draw very (48) (good). We played games together. In the evening, my mother made dumplings for (49) (we). They were delicious!
What (50) (do) you do last weekend? Please write back soon.
Yours,
Li Ming

items.exp: but 连接两个形容词，修饰 weekend 用 interesting。
讲周末发生的事，用过去式 got。
run 的过去式是不规则的 ran。
two 后接复数 eggs。
it was＋形容词描述天气，rainy。
表示一段时间，live for about seventy years。
以 f 结尾的名词，变 f 为 v 加 -es：wolves。
修饰动词 draw 用副词 well。
介词 for 后用宾格 us。
last weekend，一般过去时疑问句用助动词 did。

sections.prompt:
健康的生活习惯对我们很重要。你校英语报以“Healthy Habits, Happy Life”为题征文。请写一篇短文，内容包括：1. 你现在有哪些健康的生活习惯（饮食、运动、作息等，至少两个方面）；2. 你过去有一个不好的习惯，后来是怎样改掉的；3. 给同学们提一条建议。要求：80 词左右，开头已给出，不计入总词数；文中不得出现真实姓名和校名。
Healthy Habits, Happy Life
I think it's important to keep healthy. ______
points: 写出至少两个方面的健康习惯
写出过去的坏习惯及改掉的过程（用一般过去时）
语言准确，时态正确，衔接自然，书写规范
sections.sample:
Healthy Habits, Happy Life
I think it's important to keep healthy. Now I have some good habits. I eat breakfast every day, and I eat lots of vegetables and fruit. I exercise for an hour after school. I usually play basketball or ride my bike. I go to bed at about ten o'clock.
But last year, I often drank sweet drinks and played computer games late at night. I was often tired in class. My mother told me it was bad for my health, so I made a plan. I drank water instead and put my phone away at nine.
I hope everyone can have healthy habits. Let's exercise more and eat well!
sections.exp: 注意时态：现在的习惯用一般现在时，过去的习惯和改变过程用一般过去时。可用句型：I usually...、I used to... / Last year, I often...、so I decided to...、I hope...。
